decision.reasoning_trace: I considered the top-rated mechanical keyboards with high ratings and many reviews. I looked for products with specific features like hot-swappable switches, compact form factors, and customizable backlighting. The final choice, YMDK Idobao x ID75, stood out due to its ortholinear layout, anodized aluminum case, and hot-swappable switches, which make it a great option for those seeking customization and quality.
